name: common-agent-marketplace
description: A marketplace of Claude Code plugins covering a range of skills and agents. Manifests and skills are also readable directly by GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Superpowers teaches Claude brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD. Additionally, it teaches Claude how to author and test new skills.

plugins.name: convert-pdf-to-md
plugins.description: Converts PDF documents into Markdown so their contents can be accurately analyzed, summarized, searched, or extracted from.
